text:
katie: Heads-up: PR #5233 flags a mismatch in /v1/rerank docs. The examples show "scores" as strings ("0.78") but the runtime returns numeric floats (0.78). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5233
rafael: Linter: examples/openapi/rerank.yaml -> example.typeMismatch: expected number but got string for properties.scores.items.type
jess: Also noticed quickstart JS snippet does `results.map(r => r.score.toFixed(2))` which implies score is a string. Need to update snippets to treat score as number.
katie: Proposal: make canonical examples use numeric scores. Add a small migration note: older docs showed strings; server will accept string scores for compatibility for 14 days.
rafael: For SDK snippets, show idiomatic types (number in JS/Go/Python) and add a one-line comment mapping to raw JSON where helpful. Eg in JS: `// Raw JSON key: "score" (number)`
jess: I'll update the JS quickstart and the OpenAPI example. Patch branch: jess/rerank-score-types. Example response I'll use in the docs:```json
{
  "id": "rr_001",
  "scores": [0.78, 0.34, 0.12],
  "items": [ {"id":"doc_a"}, {"id":"doc_b"}, {"id":"doc_c"} ]
}
```
docs-bot: Automated check: docs-lint found 4 occurrences of ""scores": "" in repo (samples and quickstarts).
rafael: I'll add a docs-lint rule to validate JSON example value types against the referenced OpenAPI schema to catch these earlier. Will prototype in infra/docs-lint tomorrow.
katie: Also update components/schemas/RerankResponse to explicitly set scores.items.type: number so the linter is authoritative.
jess: Pushed branch with the changes and updated the JS snippet to parse numbers safely:```js
// SDK: results[i].score is a number
const formatted = results.map(r => r.score.toFixed(2));
```
rafael: Reviewed and left a tiny wording nit in the migration note. LGTM after that.
katie: Merged once CI turned green. Added changelog bullet: "docs: normalize rerank score types to numeric in examples" and filed SDK task INFR-412 to call out JSON mapping in each SDK README.
jess: Preview: https://deploy-preview-5233--redwood-docs.netlify.app/reference/rerank :eyes: 
docs-bot: Follow-up: scanning complete, no remaining example type mismatches on branch.
